title: Decide whether a translation bundle can ship
description: Select an evaluation slice and release policy. A bundle is blocked when any required slice or critical invariant fails, even if its aggregate score looks healthy.

policies.label: Exploration only
policies.detail: Internal, reversible use with visible warnings and no automatic downstream action.

policies.label: General release
policies.detail: User-facing content with deterministic integrity checks and no known critical errors.

policies.label: High-impact release
policies.detail: Medical, legal, safety, or irreversible content requiring stronger evidence and complete expert review.

slices.label: Spanish support
slices.detail: A mature support direction with a versioned product glossary.

slices.label: Arabic emergency alerts
slices.detail: A smaller, high-impact slice whose aggregate portfolio score hides local failures.

slices.label: Japanese catalog
slices.detail: Strong text quality with a tail-latency regression caused by longer formatted segments.

slices.label: French legal notices
slices.detail: Good automatic scores, but the policy requires complete expert review before release.
